rules: Pin the retained Barnes archive, all indexed data members, and module configuration by exact byte count and SHA-256.
Independently traverse the BZV index and decompressed BZS blocks; account for each ordered slot and exact byte slice.

Independently derive all 8,246 SWORD positions from the retained module's Versification value (or the SWORD KJV default) and the bound KJV NT canon table; compare every TEI @subtype position token and accountability position. Never derive a position from carrier text, generated Bible JSON, or neighboring payloads.

Preserve UTF-8 text in order; map only source-evidenced ThML i, br, scripRef, and blockquote elements to semantic TEI. Preserve passage and version values literally; leave unknown tags and unsupported attributes visibly escaped and explicitly accounted.
Represent empty slots explicitly and invalid UTF-8 or XML-incompatible bytes with auditable gaps and exact hex evidence; retain the existing 136 gap identities and bytes.
Independently traverse the retained ThML carrier text and compare every text and mapped-element event with readable TEI; verify explicit unknown-markup records and source structural warnings.

Validate TEI P5, exact candidate bindings, source accounting, slot order, and package reproduction; bind the ticket-local oracle module while exercising the shared reconstruction contract as the current runtime dependency.
Reject omission, duplication, reordering, changed text, changed ThML semantics or attributes, changed byte evidence, and hidden source gaps.
